Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 3
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely accepted a misleading search snippet that attributed the film “I Love, You Love” to Alain Resnais, without verifying the film’s actual director. The 1989 Czechoslovak film “I Love, You Love” (Ja milujem, ty miluješ) was directed by Dušan Hanák, not Alain Resnais. This initial misidentification led the workflow to pursue the wrong director’s birthplace, causing the downstream solution to be incorrect.
